data.text: Pointer-chasing deep hierarchical scene graph trees during pan and zoom culling causes CPU cache misses. Flattening spatial bounding boxes (AABBs), visibility flags, and page membership into contiguous Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) slices enables vectorizable, cache-efficient frustum culling.
data.evidence: Instead of pointer-chasing deep Rust tree nodes during pan/zoom culling, `SceneIndex` packs world-space AABBs (`min_x`, `min_y`, `max_x`, `max_y`), visibility flags, and page membership into contiguous Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) slices for cache-friendly frustum culling.

data.text: Rebuilding or re-uploading complete vertex and instance buffers on every canvas mutation scales with total document size O(N). Appending modified node IDs to a bounded dirty log allows frame preparation to patch only the dirty GPU buffer slots in O(k) time.
data.evidence: Canvas mutations append node IDs to a bounded `DirtyLog` rather than rebuilding the full vertex/instance buffer every frame. Frame preparation updates only the `k` dirty node slots (`O(k)` vs `O(N)`).
